settings.question: What is Up Men and how does it work?
settings.answer: Up Men is a natural testosterone support supplement made with 8 clinically dosed ingredients — including Tongkat Ali, Shilajit, Fenugreek, Zinc and Boron — that work together to support your body's own testosterone production, energy, strength and focus.

settings.question: How do I take Up Men?
settings.answer: Take the daily serving with water, ideally in the morning with food. Consistency is key — take it every day for at least 90 days for full results.

settings.question: When will I feel the results?
settings.answer: Most men start noticing improved energy and workout intensity within the first 7 days. By day 30 you should see visible changes, and by day 90 your T-production is fully optimized. That's why we back it with a 90-day guarantee.

settings.question: Is Up Men a hormone or a steroid?
settings.answer: No. Up Men is 100% hormone-free. It doesn't put synthetic testosterone in your body — it supports your body's own natural ability to produce testosterone.

settings.question: Are there any side effects?
settings.answer: Up Men is made with natural ingredients at clinically studied doses and is generally well tolerated. If you have a medical condition or take medication, consult your doctor before use.

settings.question: Is it third-party tested?
settings.answer: Yes. Every batch is manufactured in a CGMP facility in the USA and third-party tested for purity and potency. Non-GMO, vegan and hormone-free.

settings.question: How does the 90-day guarantee work?
settings.answer: Try Up Men for 90 days. If you don't feel a difference, contact our support and we'll refund your purchase — no questions asked.

settings.question: How does the subscription work? Can I cancel?
settings.answer: Your Launch Kit ships every 30 days at 50% off the one-time price. You can cancel, skip or pause your subscription anytime through the customer portal — no phone calls, no hassle.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders placed today ship within 24 hours. Delivery typically takes 2–5 business days within the continental USA.

settings.question: Who should use Up Men?
settings.answer: Up Men was designed for men 18+ who want to support healthy testosterone levels, energy, strength and drive — whether you're in your 20s and want an edge, or 40+ and want to feel like yourself again.
